A final word

For you,
Rahul Sir.

Happy birthday · 29 November 2026

Some teachers teach a subject. The rare ones teach you how to see — how a proof can be beautiful, how a problem can be patient, and how an idea, once understood, can change the way you move through the world.

In your classes, mathematics was never just numbers on a board, and computing was never just lines on a screen. They were ways of thinking clearly, of being curious, of trying again. You made difficult things feel possible, and you made all of us feel that we were capable of more than we knew.

On your birthday, we wanted to give something back — not as grand as what you have given us, but honest. These messages are small pieces of a much larger thank you.

We wish you a year of good health, quiet joys, and the same wonder you bring into every room. Happy birthday, Rahul Sir.

With respect, affection, and gratitude,
The Class of 2026

With love from

Every one of us.
